description: Nigeria - Kano State Settlement Dataset is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by Shaky Sherpa (World Bank Group). Data on Nigeria Settlement Location and Distribution downloaded from the The Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation Vaccination Tracking System (VTS). To learn more about the VTS project, please visit. Coverage: Nigeria. It has 2 files in GeoJSON, CSV. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
